newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks open at record highs, await UK data.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks open at record highs, await UK data.

text.p: The UK stock market continued its record-breaking run on Monday morning, buoyed by all-time highs on Wall Street on Friday, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index punched past its previous all-time high of 4,205.1 set on Friday to a record 4,044.3 points some fifteen minutes after the start of official trade, up 19.5 points on the day.

Dealers attributed the rise to the 60-point gain on Wall Street after the surprise drop in U.S. employment data that sent markets soaring amid hopes the U.S. Federal Reserve would delay or even back off from a widely-expected interest rate rise.
Trade was slow ahead of British industrial production data due at 0830 GMT.
